summary: Staff bring different service procedures to the board for a sudden closure and a planned renovation.
realLife: After the trustees discussed South End services in September 2023, library administrators explained the procedures for short, long and unexpected closures at the November meeting.
inGame: needs: closure reason and estimated duration.

turns.pulledBy: A short outage extends beyond the original estimate.
turns.what: The trustee asks staff to revisit the short-term arrangements.
turns.writesBack: The next agenda includes service for the longer interval.

turns.pulledBy: An inspection clears the branch for its scheduled reopening.
turns.writesBack: The reopening notice names the last off-site session.
